message: Preregistered a same-data, same-model replacement that encodes the frozen 16.6M tokenizer once per 160-frame record and trains dynamics from latent ArrayRecords. No offline latent shards or CR-DYN-0011 optimizer updates exist yet.
Frozen the tested offline-latent implementation before remote execution. The exact source passed 166 tests, experiment-ledger validation, all CoinRun shell syntax checks and git diff checks.
